description: What the window is allowed to ask the system for. "core:default" aggregates nine permission sets, i.e. ninety-two permissions, including the twenty-eight from "core:window:default" — which already grant double-click to maximize and the primary monitor, but NEITHER minimize, NOR toggle-maximize, NOR close, NOR start-dragging: the undecorated title bar claims them by name. "opener:allow-open-path" opens a launcher folder in the file explorer; it's in no default set, and its absence shows up as an ACL refusal only in a packaged build, never in tauri dev. The "windows" list names the TWO windows the front end drives: the main one and the sign-in one. A window absent from this list opens normally and has every one of its calls refused, with no console saying so in development.
